course_name_en: Fundamentals of Driver Assistance Systems and Automated Driving

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the classification, objectives, and function of driver assistance systems and automated driving, including technical terminology and the state of the art.
Be able to apply the fundamentals of driver assistance systems and automated driving in relation to technical requirements, data processing, and the interface to the vehicle user.
Acquire the competence to define and develop driver assistance functions and an understanding of necessary sensors and actuators and their operating principles.
Be able to reproduce basic knowledge regarding data processing, data fusion, and model building, and categorize the relationships between components, subsystems, function, and other vehicle systems.
Be able to fundamentally evaluate systems and components in terms of benefits, application possibilities, and limitations.
Recognize the paradigm shift in individual mobility through higher automation and its individual, societal, and ethical aspects.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of function development: traffic, human performance and information processing, road safety
Driver assistance functions: driving, parking / maneuvering
Active safety systems: e.g., emergency braking, preventive pedestrian protection, light & vision; fundamentals of vehicle safety and accident research
Fundamentals and aspects of automated driving
Fundamentals of designing human-machine interface elements (display/operation concept)
